title: TextEDA IR v0.4 — manifest shard
description: Shard manifest and hashes: one sha256 per shard (computed over the canonical JSON bytes); the board hash and project hash are recomputed by rule and not persisted. See ADR-0008 decision 5.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool that produced the IR; the other half of artifact traceability.

shards.description: Shard list: path and content hash of each shard.

path.description: Shard path relative to dist/ir/, e.g. boards/charger-buck/schematic.json.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of this shard's canonical JSON bytes.

source_hash.description: Project hash = SHA-256(concatenation of "<path>:<sha256>\n" lines after sorting shards by path). The board hash uses the same rule over the subset of that board's shards.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.
